c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Require Photo ID for Voting
c.q: Constitutional amendment to require all voters not just those presenting to vote in person to present photo identification before voting.

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Maximum Income Tax Rate of 3.5%
c.q: Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Property Tax Levy Limit
c.q: Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.

c.t: City of Kannapolis Parks and Recreation Bonds Referendum
c.q: Additional property taxes may be levied on property located in the City of Kannapolis in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on bonds if approved by the following ballot question.SHALL the order authorizing $40000000 of bonds plus interest to provide funds to pay the capital costs of acquiring constructing renovating and improving parks and recreation facilities including without limitation athletic fields parks playgrounds greenways and open space for active and passive use including the acquisition of any necessary furnishing and equipment land rights-of-way and easements and providing that additional taxes may be levied in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on the bonds be approved in light of the following:(1) The estimated cumulative cost over the life of the bonds using the highest interest rate charged for similar debt over the last 20 years would be $62444800 (consisting of $40000000 principal amount of the bonds plus $22444800 of interest).(2) The estimated amount of property tax liability increase for each one hundred thousand dollars ($100000) of property tax value to service the cumulative cost over the life of the bond provided above would be $46.00 per year.
